subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a constitutional body?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Reserve bank of India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**:

 
 
• It is **not a constitutional body**; it is a **statutory body** established under the **Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934**.
 
• RBI is known as the 'Central Bank of India' whose primary function to regulate the issue of Banknotes and keeping of reserves with a view to securing monetary stability in India and generally to operate the currency and credit system of the country.
 
• RBI is also known as 'Apex Bank of India'.
 
• RBI is also known as 'Banker's Bank'.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Constitutional Body
 Article
 Key Function
 
 

 National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC)
 Article 338B
 Advises the government on policies for the development of socially and educationally backward classes.
 
 

 Comptroller and Auditor-General of India (CAG)
 Article 148
 Audits the accounts of the Union and State governments and ensures transparency in financial administration.
 
 

 Election Commission of India (ECI)
 Article 324
 Conducts free and fair elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of the President and Vice-President.
 
 

These bodies are integral to the framework of India's governance and accountability.
